logic.summary: Long-only H1 medium-horizon momentum model: stay long while closed bar Close[1] > Close[91]; exit flat otherwise.
logic.economic_rationale: Captures multi-day directional drift over ~90 H1 bars (~4 trading days).
known_assumptions: Evaluates strictly on closed H1 bars (shift 1 vs shift 91) at each new H1 bar open.
No hard SL/TP; risk exit is signal reversal (Close[1] <= Close[91]).
rejection_criteria: Net Out-of-Sample expectancy after spread, swap, and slippage <= 0.
High drawdown concentration during sideways/mean-reverting regimes without compensating trend payoff.
